review_method: Visual inspection of every second decoded frame across the entire MP4 plus native-resolution transition frames, followed by native initial PNG
initial_scene: Middle third-person view only: a tan small drawer cabinet stands on an orange tabletop mat, with its upper drawer closed; an elongated gray rectangular block lies to its right. The active white-and-blue arm is behind the cabinet with an empty gripper. Another arm remains stationary in the left foreground. A black curtain and metal table surround the working area.

observed_sequence.action: Active arm initially holds its empty gripper behind the closed cabinet; drawer and gray block remain stationary.
Gripper approaches and closes on the upper drawer front on the far/right side of the cabinet. Exact contact is partially hidden by the drawer front and cabinet.
Arm pulls the upper drawer out to the right/back in the image, exposing the empty drawer interior. Cabinet shifts slightly during the pull.
Drawer remains fully extended; gripper releases the drawer front, visibly opening by frame 274. First drawer-opening manipulation is complete.
Released gripper moves toward the gray rectangular block to the right of the cabinet, lowers around it and closes.
Arm lifts the gray block, carries it over the open drawer and releases it inside. The block is visibly resting in the drawer at frame 416 as the empty gripper rises.
Empty gripper withdraws upward, then returns toward the drawer front to begin closing. Gray block remains inside the extended drawer.
Arm pushes the drawer inward; by the final frame the drawer is closed and the gray block is concealed inside.

selected_segment.reason: Retains the first complete meaningful manipulation, opening the upper drawer, including approach, pull and release. Frame 274 shows the released gripper and fully extended drawer before the distinct transition toward the gray block.
selected_segment.terminal_state: Upper drawer is open with its empty interior exposed; gripper has released its front; gray block remains untouched on the tabletop.

full_sequence_prompt: The robotic arm opens the upper drawer, picks up the gray rectangular block and places it inside, then closes the drawer with the block inside. Keep the camera fixed; preserve robot geometry, physically valid joint motion, and normal gripper opening and closing.
world_model_prompt: The robotic arm grasps the upper drawer and pulls it open, leaving the drawer extended after releasing it. Keep the camera fixed; preserve robot geometry, physically valid joint motion, and normal gripper opening and closing.
uncertainties: Exact drawer-front grasp contact is partly occluded by the cabinet and drawer front in the middle view.
The gray object is visibly a rectangular block; its material or specific identity cannot be determined from the view.
Phase boundaries are approximate except the selected endpoint, which is grounded in native frame 274.
